name: unsafe fn realloc (& self , ptr : * mut u8 , layout : Layout , new_size : usize) -> * mut u8
rule: For safety, `layout` must be the same layout used to allocate the block referenced by `ptr`.
api: trait GlobalAlloc  : { unsafe fn realloc (& self , ptr : * mut u8 , layout : core::alloc::layout::Layout , new_size : usize) -> * mut u8 }
